scope: Shared legacy-forward and reciprocal LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD association identity validation, plus generated R2007 string-padding observer correction; not legacy output qualification.

authority.finding: R13/R14 BLOCK_HEADER has no LAYOUT backlink; LAYOUT carries the block record forward reference. R2000+ BLOCK_HEADER carries a layout handle.

changes: Shared resolver checks all non-null source pointers, nonzero/non-sentinel identities and matching map keys before dereference; associated block targets cannot use the sentinel. Legacy R2000 projection reuses the shared identity validation. Failures preserve the previously supplied association map and corrected retries succeed in both modes.

A generated R2007 dictionary/layout wire observer now expects the current writer's directly concatenated logical string bits and combined-stream footer alignment, rather than an extra byte-rounded carrier. Its separate bit-packed footer controls exercise both forms, alignment residues, corruption and truncation. No production stream encoding changed.
baseline: A clean build at the base commit and two older binaries reproduced the pre-existing AC1021 dictionary observer padding failure; the corrected observer passes the same owning test.

validation.sanitizers: shared identity test passed with Clang address and undefined-behavior sanitizers
validation.qualification: clean indexed-tree implementation digest and format support metadata passed; 15 claims experimental and zero advertised

limitations: R13/R14 source acceptance and native dictionary cloning semantics are not established.
Legacy LAYOUT writer projection remains disabled until its source graph, viewport ownership, writer identities and staged output are qualified together.
The generated-wire footer controls do not establish independent producer or native DWG interoperability.
Hosted checks for this changed implementation remain pending.
